data.rationale: The proposal has the right four-site sequence and the right goal, but it is vague on specifics: it says "cheapest flight" where the true workflow reads the first/best flight, and "a hotel" where the true workflow needs the first with a review score of 8 or more. It also has no consent-page handling and no do-not-click constraints, and it treats the activity as "top attraction" instead of a "{activity} {destination}" search, so the activity parameter is muddled and the note format is only loosely specified.
